content: Legacy-peer-deps masks real ERESOLVE conflicts; correct fix is to identify the offending peer range and bump or replace that package. Empirically verified for this repo via npm dry-run installs: vite-plugin-pwa 1.2.0 peer range excludes vite 8, fixed in 1.3.0; vitepress-plugin-mermaid 2.0.17, last published Sept 2024, peer-depends on vitepress 1.x only and has no version compatible with vitepress 2.x.
